frames.u: Most of your week should feel easy.
Full sentences, no gasping. That's easy pace.
Go easy on easy days, hard on hard days.
Save this for your next easy run.

reel1.caption:
Your easy runs are probably too fast. Most runners' are.
If you can't chat in full sentences, slow down. Easy days make the hard days count.

frames.u: Stops for the sunrise. Every. Single. Week.
Honestly only here for the after-party.
Talks the whole way. Somehow never out of breath.
Arrives as you leave. Still beats everyone back.
Which one are you? Tell me below.

Every run club has these six people. You know exactly who they are.

slides.sub: Count how many fit you. We'll wait.

slides.title: 5am is normal
slides.head: Your alarm goes off before the birds.
slides.body: And somehow you're annoyed when the weekend run starts at 7.

slides.title: Kit everywhere
slides.head: Half your washing is running kit.
slides.body: The other half is the socks you swore you'd throw away.

slides.title: Pace in your head
slides.head: You convert everything into minutes per km.
slides.body: Even the drive to work. Especially the drive to work.

slides.title: Always hungry
slides.head: Second breakfast is a real meal.
slides.body: Long run Saturday means the fridge doesn't stand a chance.

slides.title: Wind forecasts
slides.head: You check the wind before the rain.
slides.body: Cape Town runners know: a 40 km/h headwind changes everything.

slides.title: It comes up
slides.head: Every conversation ends up at your next race.
slides.body: Nobody asked. You told them anyway. With splits.
